title: CauTion: Knowing When to Trust LLMs for Ensemble Causal Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2606.03602v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Causal discovery from observational data remains challenging due to the fundamental limitations of purely statistical methods, such as statistical distinguishability within equivalence classes and sensitivity to finite sample sizes. While large language models (LLMs) offer a promising source of domain knowledge to complement statistical inference, existing LLM-augmented methods are vulnerable to LLM errors and incur high token costs. Moreover, reliance on a single data-centric algorithm can make results sensitive to algorithm-specific biases. To address these limitations, we propose CauTion, a framework that reliably integrates LLM domain knowledge into an ensemble of statistical causal discovery algorithms through consensus filtering and LLM reliability estimation. translated_title: CauTion：知道何时信任大语言模型进行集成因果发现
translated_abstract: 从观测数据中进行因果发现仍然具有挑战性，原因在于纯统计方法存在根本性局限，例如等价类内部的统计不可区分性以及对有限样本量的敏感性。虽然大语言模型（LLM）为补充统计推断提供了有前景的领域知识来源，但现有的LLM增强方法容易受到LLM错误的影响，且产生高昂的token成本。此外，依赖单一以数据为中心的算法会使结果对算法特有的偏差敏感。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了CauTion，一个通过共识过滤和LLM可靠性估计，将LLM领域知识可靠地集成到统计因果发现算法集成中的框架。CauTion分三个阶段进行。首先，算法集成利用共识投票解决多达96%的算法间达成一致的边，实现接近完美的（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出CauTion框架，通过共识过滤和LLM可靠性估计，将大语言模型的领域知识可靠地融合进统计因果发现算法集成中，从而同时克服纯统计方法、LLM错误风险和单一算法偏差这三方面的局限。
en_tdlr: CauTion is a framework that reliably integrates LLM domain knowledge into an ensemble of statistical causal discovery algorithms via consensus filtering and LLM reliability estimation, overcoming the limitations of purely statistical methods, LLM errors, and algorithm-specific biases.
